title: Register the property for livestock (PIC)
what: Register for a property identification code (PIC) for land where livestock are kept, and identify and record livestock movements under the NLIS.

sources.title: Biosecurity (National Livestock Identification System) Regulation 2017 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: 7 Property identification code required if certain animals held in captivity (1) The owner and the occupier (if that person is not the owner) of a property on which any of the following stock are held in captivity, and the owner and the person in charge (if that person is not the owner) of any of the following stock held in captivity on a property, must each ensure that the property has a property identification code
